slides.name: 00-title
slides.notes: Open with Echo as an operational collaboration layer, not merely another chat application.

slides.name: 01-jenkins-builds
slides.notes: One evolving message per build. Mention the trigger owner only when action is required.

slides.name: 02-daily-prod-errors
slides.notes: Aggregate by stable workload and error fingerprint—not ephemeral pod name.

slides.name: 03-nightly-build-status
slides.notes: The nightly is a cross-system qualification story, with regressions compared to the previous baseline.

slides.name: 04-version-releases
slides.notes: Connect release notes to artifacts and environment rollout state.

slides.name: 05-team-pr-alert-channels
slides.notes: Different channels carry different expectations: conversation, review, and action.

slides.name: 06-team-owned-e2e
slides.notes: Ownership metadata makes the routing layer reusable across every integration.

slides.name: 07-garp-ai
slides.notes: Garp answers in a thread, cites evidence, and recommends next steps while preserving human judgment.
